ai.title: Skip static generation for publisher and agent pages
ai.summary: Removes generateStaticParams from web/src/app/publishers/[id]/page.tsx, web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/page.tsx, and web/src/app/publishers/[id]/agents/[agentId]/[version]/page.tsx. Eliminates fetchAgentsForStaticParams and getCachedAgentsForStaticParams from web/src/server/agents-data.ts. Pages now render dynamically with 10-minute ISR revalidation, preventing build timeouts during static generation.

eli5.text: Publisher and agent pages now load on demand instead of being pre-built at deploy time, which prevents build timeouts. If you visit a publisher, agent, or specific agent version page, it renders fresh content within 10 minutes rather than relying on a snapshot created during deployment. This change affects only internal web pages for publisher profiles and their associated agents.

ai.title: Fix stale check in use-activity-query for error states
ai.summary: Updated isEntryStale in cli/src/hooks/use-activity-query.ts to treat entries with recent errors as fresh. Logic now checks dataUpdatedAt first, then errorUpdatedAt if no successful data exists. Prevents rapid retries on persistent errors by respecting staleTime for error timestamps. Affects CLI activity polling mechanism.

eli5.text: When the CLI polls for activity and hits repeated errors, it now waits longer before retrying instead of hammering the server over and over. If there hasn't been a successful response yet, the tool considers an entry fresh as long as an error happened within the configured wait window, so persistent failures don't trigger a tight retry loop. You'd notice this as fewer frantic retry attempts in the logs when something keeps erroring out during polling.

ai.title: Fix advisory lock bugs causing Discord bot to fail to start
ai.summary: Advisory lock logic in packages/internal/src/db/advisory-lock.ts updated to prevent Discord bot startup failures. Changes include coercing postgres boolean strings ('t'/'f') to native booleans, disabling connection recycling (max_lifetime: 0) to maintain session state, and adding guards against stacking health checks and premature lock loss triggers. This ensures reliable lock acquisition and monitoring for internal services.

eli5.text: Your Discord bot will now start reliably instead of getting stuck or crashing during startup. The bot uses a coordination system where only one instance is allowed to run at a time by claiming an exclusive lock on the database; several bugs were preventing that lock from being acquired or monitored correctly. Those bugs are now fixed, so the bot should boot up and stay running without manual intervention. The fix is live and applies to all internal services that depend on this startup coordination.

ai.title: CLI direnv integration
ai.summary: Added `initializeDirenv` to CLI startup to load `.envrc` variables. Searches up to git root for `.envrc`, checks `direnv` availability (skips Windows), and applies exports via `direnv export json`. New file `cli/src/init/init-direnv.ts` handles logic; `cli/src/init/init-app.ts` triggers it before theme/project init. Blocked `.envrc` files log a warning prompting `direnv allow`.

ai.title: CLI init-direnv.ts added to process.env allowlist
ai.summary: scripts/check-env-architecture.ts now permits cli/src/init/init-direnv.ts to access process.env. This resolves a CI failure where the architecture check blocked direnv variable loading. The change applies to the CLI package's restricted imports enforcement.

eli5.text: When you start your computer's command-line tools, a small setup step loads special environment variables that Direnv manages. A background check that verifies which parts of the system are allowed to read those variables was previously blocking that load, causing the tool to fail during automated testing. That check now permits the Direnv setup file to read the variables, so the startup sequence runs without being stopped. The change is live now in the tool's source code, though you wouldn't see any visible difference if you weren't watching the testing process.

ai.title: Fix infinite retries in CLI useActivityQuery hook
ai.summary: Fixed infinite retry loops in `cli/src/hooks/use-activity-query.ts` by separating timeout cleanup from state reset. The retry scheduling logic now calls `clearRetryTimeout` instead of `clearRetryState`, preventing accidental reset of `retryCounts`. Staleness checks now use `isEntryStale` to consider `errorUpdatedAt`, avoiding rapid refetch loops on persistent errors. Added `_retryTestHelpers` and `setErrorOnlyCacheEntry` to expose internal state for unit testing.

eli5.text: The CLI tool used to get stuck repeatedly retrying the same failed operation forever when it couldn't fetch data. Now, when a fetch fails, the tool only cancels its retry timer without resetting its failure count, which lets it give up after the proper number of attempts instead of looping endlessly. You'll notice this if you saw the CLI spinning or freezing during a network error before. This is live today in the CLI.
